units.source_text: 此事终于泄露出去。

en.t: At last, the matter leaked out.

units.source_text: 世人纷纷议论：

en.t: People everywhere began talking about it:

units.source_text: “源氏内大臣爱上前斋院了。

en.t: “Minister Genji has fallen in love with the former High Priestess of Kamo.

units.source_text: 五公主也说这二人是天生一对。

en.t: Princess Five also says the two of them are a match made by heaven.

units.source_text: 这真是一段门当户对的好姻缘呵！”

en.t: It would truly be an excellent marriage between families of equal rank!”

units.source_text: 这些话传入紫姬耳中，

en.t: When these words reached Lady Murasaki’s ears,

units.source_text: 起初她想：“如果真有此事，他总不会瞒我。”

en.t: at first she thought, “If there were really such a thing, surely he would not hide it from me.”

units.source_text: 后来仔细观察，发见公子神色大变，常常若有所思，神不守舍。

en.t: Later, watching him closely, she noticed that the prince’s expression had changed greatly; he often seemed lost in thought and quite distracted.

units.source_text: 她这才担心起来：

en.t: Only then did she begin to worry:

units.source_text: “原来他已相思刻骨，在我面前却装作若无其事，说起时也用戏言蒙混过去。”

en.t: “So he is already lovesick to the bone, yet in front of me he pretends nothing is wrong, and when it comes up he brushes it aside with jokes.”

units.source_text: 又想：

en.t: She also thought:

units.source_text: “这槿姬与我同是亲王血统，但她的声望特别高，一向受人重视。

en.t: “This Lady Asagao and I are both of princely blood, but her reputation is especially high, and she has always been held in great esteem.

units.source_text: 如果公子的心偏向了她，于我甚是不利呢。

en.t: If the prince’s heart turns toward her, it will be very bad for me.

units.source_text: 我多年来备受公子宠爱，无人能与我比肩，幸福已经享惯了。

en.t: For many years I have enjoyed the prince’s deep affection, with no one able to rival me, and I have grown used to such happiness.

units.source_text: 如今若果被他人压倒，岂不伤心！”

en.t: If now I were truly overshadowed by someone else, how could I not be heartbroken!”

units.source_text: 她暗自悲叹。

en.t: She grieved and sighed in secret.

units.source_text: 继而又想：

en.t: Then she thought again:

units.source_text: “那时即使不完全忘却旧情而与我绝交，也一定很看轻我。

en.t: “At that point, even if he does not completely forget his old affection and break with me, he will surely think much less of me.

units.source_text: 他那自幼爱护我、多年来照顾我的深情厚意，必将成为无足轻重，有无皆可了。”

en.t: The deep kindness and affection with which he has cherished me since childhood and cared for me over so many years will surely become something of little importance, something he can take or leave.”

units.source_text: 她左思右想，心绪恼乱。

en.t: She thought this way and that, her mind troubled and confused.

units.source_text: 倘是寻常小事，不妨向他发泄几句不伤感情的怨言。

en.t: If it had been some ordinary minor matter, she could have let out a few complaints to him without damaging their feelings.

units.source_text: 但这是一件关系重大的恨事，所以不便形之于色。

en.t: But this was a grievance of grave importance, so she could not let it show on her face.

units.source_text: 源氏公子只管枯坐窗前，沉思冥想，又常常在宫中住宿。

en.t: Prince Genji merely sat listlessly by the window, sunk in deep thought, and he often spent the night at court.

units.source_text: 一有空闲，便埋头写信，好像这就是他的公务。

en.t: Whenever he had a moment free, he bent over writing letters, as though that were his official duty.

units.source_text: 紫姬想：

en.t: Lady Murasaki thought:

units.source_text: “外间的传说果然不是虚言！

en.t: “So the rumors outside were not false after all!

units.source_text: 他的心事也该多少透露一点给我才是。”

en.t: He ought to reveal at least a little of what is on his mind to me.”

units.source_text: 为此心绪一直不宁。

en.t: Because of this, her heart remained unsettled.
